evidence.title: GitHub - reacherhq/check-if-email-exists: Check if an email address exists without sending any email, written in Rust.

name: Reacher
summary: Open-source email verification API that checks addresses by talking SMTP to mail servers to reduce bounce rates.
description: Reacher verifies email addresses over SMTP — mailbox existence, MX records, disposable providers and catch-all domains. Self-host the MIT-licensed Rust engine for free, use the managed pay-as-you-go API, or route verification through its Port 25 SMTP proxy infrastructure.
contains: verifies mailbox existence, MX records, disposable providers and catch-all domains over SMTP
self-hostable Rust engine check-if-email-exists (10k+ GitHub stars, MIT)
managed API with pay-as-you-go pricing, 10M+ requests per day handled
REST API documented with cURL, Node.js, Python and Go snippets
SMTP proxies from $49/month for up to 300,000 verification connections
